description: This script generates default font family configurations for Chromium across different platforms by parsing locale resource files and mapping script names to font families.

classes.name: ScriptFontFamilies
classes.description: A class that manages mapping of scripts to font families and serializes this data to JSON.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets a font family for a specific script within the ScriptFontFamilies class.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the ScriptFontFamilies instance to a JSON-compatible object.
